judge.question: Read every card, shape, detail and label. Does any of them state a value, owner, mechanism, cost, date or behaviour that the source leaves open or contradicts, without marking it as unresolved?
judge.pass: Every contradiction shows both sides; every gap is shown as a gap; the user-service link says only 'uses' or flags its uncertainty.
judge.fail: Any single retention value or cadence presented as the design, a named registry owner, a 'calls synchronously' or 'reads replica' edge, a dead-letter queue, or a cost figure.

assertions.description: Uncertainty is visible where it applies.

judge.question: Can a reader tell at a glance which parts of the canvas are stated facts and which are conflicts or open questions, both in the separate frame and on the design elements they concern (warehouse, registry, the user-service link)?
judge.pass: A distinct open-questions frame, and the disputed design elements carry a short 'disputed / not decided / unclear' note.
judge.fail: Conflicts are only in prose somewhere, or the design diagram looks fully settled.
